title: Cullet: the quay and the Strand's backs
description: Cullet walked from fixed viewpoints (plan frame points in .local/layout1/tools/views.txt): the game camera (default: 22 m, 28 degrees down, looking north), a walking camera (close, or YAW_PITCH_DISTANCE_FOV low shots) and looks along the street, at 13:00 (day-) and 18:30 (dusk-).
